overview: This table holds the translated words shown during practice tasks, help screens, and Gojo's tutorial conversations.
description: Localized tutorial text for every tutorial surface: in-battle practice task instructions and command icon labels, configuration-screen in-game/out-game tutorial headings and long help bodies, and the Gojo tutorial-battle dialogue. The 163 IDs comprise 25 task messages, 20 task command labels, 18 in-game labels, 18 in-game messages, 16 character messages, 27 out-game labels, and 39 out-game messages.

ID.simple: The name that tells the game which practice instruction, help-page words, key label, or Gojo line to show.
ID.technical: FName ID in FGameDataTableRow_GameText. In every language export ID equals the row key (the export metadata records ImportKeyField='Id'), but AGameTextManager::FindTextRow passes the requested FName to UDataTable::FindRow, so the operative lookup key is the row name; this property is not scanned. Non-SYS_ ids search the ordered 14-table GameText array and return the first match; TutorialTextDataTable_<Language> is the tenth added table (zero-based index 9 when all tables resolve). Task ids are literal FNames in FStudioBattleSystem390, help labels are literal FNames in the config widgets, page ids come from TutorialWidgetDataTable.Id_TutorialLabel/Id_TutorialMessage, and dialogue ids come from BattleTalkDataTable.TextId.

Text.simple: What the player reads as a practice instruction, help explanation, key label, or Gojo dialogue in each language.
Text.technical: FString Text at row offset +0x10. GetGameText copies Row->Text and passes it through FormatText; GetText routes non-SYS_ requests here, and a missing row yields an empty string. All 11 export shards contain the same 163 keys and no empty Text. The En export has 13 tags, 79 tags, and LF in 54 rows, with no ; each Chinese shard has two tags in TUT_OUTGAME_MESSAGE_0901_10. GLO keys are substituted from the GlossaryTextDataTable_ parameter map rebuilt on text load; tags are Slate rich-text/input-guide decorator runs, not FormatText tags (its regex only matches uppercase [mods]). NAME_None is a consumer-side sentinel on task Message/CommandLabel FNames that collapses the corresponding widget; it is not a stored Text value. LF is preserved unless the receiving widget has bForceOneLine, in which case GameText_JoinLines removes CRLF/LF for Ja/Zh_Hant/Zh_Hans and replaces them with a space for other languages; retail widget flag values are not available.

notes: Storage and loading: FGameDataTableRow_GameText has only ID and Text. The 11 export variants are De, En, Es, Es_LA, Fr, It, Ja, Ko, Pt, Zh_Hans and Zh_Hant; each has exactly the same 163 row keys and no empty Text. GameTextManager::Tick adds the language table tenth of 14 (index 9 when all resolve), and Config/DefaultGame.ini lines 35-45 assign the TextDataTable_<suffix> families to chunks 1-11.

Lookup precedence: ids beginning with SYS_ route to SystemTextDataTable rather than this table. All other ids are searched in the fixed GameText table order and the first row-name match wins, so a duplicate id in an earlier table would shadow this one. FindTextRow skips lookup only when its caller passes bCheckNone and the id is NAME_None; GetGameText does not, and a missing row renders empty.

Battle tasks: FStudioBattleSystem390 BuildTutorial01000M/01006M/02022M embed literal task message and command-label FNames (BuildTutorial09106M only suspends the tutorial). Type, Params, Rate and completion thresholds such as 6.0f, 500.0f, 3.0f or 0.0f are C++ task fields, not columns of this table; there is no row lookup by numeric TaskId. UGameBattleHUDWidget::OpenPracticeTasks reads the selected task by id and calls SetTask; NAME_None message/label ids collapse their widget rather than displaying an empty row.

Help pages: GameConfigTutorialWidget supplies 16 TUT_INGAME_LABEL ids with enum payloads 1-16, and GameConfigHelpWidget supplies 21 TUT_OUTGAME_LABEL ids with payloads 17-37 (including the non-sequential 1301=34, 1401=35, 1501=36, 1601=37). ShowTutorialTypes filters the 54 rows of TutorialWidgetDataTable by EGameTutorialWidgetType, preserving table order; those rows reference 99 distinct label/message ids here. SetPage reads Rows[Page], uses texture slots [0] and [1] to choose the layout and rich-text block, and rewrites TUT_OUTGAME_MESSAGE_1301 to TUT_OUTGAME_MESSAGE_1304 before lookup.

Character dialogue and markup: the 16 TUT_INGAME_CHARACTER_MESSAGE ids are BattleTalkDataTable.TextId values in six STMSN_01000M_0X sets; FBattleStoryState_TutorialTalk queues those sets and GameBattleTalkWidget applies TextId to SerifText. GLO tags use the glossary parameter cache; the two Chinese DYN=FRIEND_WORD occurrences resolve from request parameters, with the Chinese special case in FormatText. is rendered by the rich-text/input-guide decorator and is left untouched by FormatText.

Evidence scope: status/functions.json records FindTextRow 0x14af290 and Tick 0x14c96f0 as behavioural (BEHAV records NA15 and BG03 respectively), while GetText/GetGameText/FormatText are byte-matched. Only partial packaged Content is available and retail widget Blueprints/default properties were not inspected, so widget bForceOneLine values, icon-brush availability, and any Blueprint-only presentation behaviour are not claimed. Three export ids have no traced consumer in the available C++ or export relationships: TUT_INGAME_TASK_COMMAND_LABEL_0018, TUT_OUTGAME_MESSAGE_1302 and TUT_OUTGAME_MESSAGE_1303.

usages.detail: Defines compiled practice tasks with literal TUT_INGAME_TASK_MESSAGE_* and TUT_INGAME_TASK_COMMAND_LABEL_* FNames; task type/Params/Rate and numeric thresholds stay in C++.
OpenPracticeTasks resolves the selected task through BattleManager and passes Row.Message and Row.CommandLabel to the practice widget.
Applies the message id with SetTextIdOnly and collapses TaskDetailText when it is NAME_None; the command label is handled the same way at line 53.
Creates 16 in-game tutorial buttons from literal TUT_INGAME_LABEL_* ids with tutorial type ids 1-16.
Creates 21 out-game help buttons from literal TUT_OUTGAME_LABEL_* ids with tutorial type ids 17-37.
SetPage resolves the current TutorialWidgetDataTable row label into HeaderText, then its message at line 182 after the 1301-to-1304 alias; texture indices [0]/[1] select the rich-text block.
Applies the BattleTalkDataTable.TextId value, including the 16 TUT_INGAME_CHARACTER_MESSAGE_* ids, to SerifText.
Loads TutorialTextDataTable_<Language> into the ordered 14-table GameText array used by first-match non-SYS_ lookups.
Recognises runs and resolves the icon brush; the input-guide decorator supplies keyboard/controller variants.
